disclaimer: These are original practice topics written for this app. They are not official IELTS questions and are not taken from any exam board or candidate-report bank.

topics.title: Your neighbourhood
questions: Do you like the neighbourhood where you live? Why or why not?
What facilities are available near your home?
Has your neighbourhood changed much in recent years?
Would you prefer to live in a quieter or a busier area?

topics.title: Reading habits
questions: How often do you read for pleasure?
Do you prefer paper books or digital books?
What kinds of books did you enjoy as a child?
Do you think people read less nowadays than in the past?

topics.title: A time a stranger helped you
topics.cueCard: Describe a time when a stranger helped you.
bullets: what they did to help you
and explain how you felt afterwards
part3: Why do some people hesitate to help strangers?
Should cities encourage more community volunteering? Why or why not?
How has technology changed the way people ask for help?
Do you think people are kinder in small towns than in large cities?
